import math

# Calculate 64!
factorial_64 = math.factorial(64)

# Convert to string and sum the digits
digit_sum = sum(int(digit) for digit in str(factorial_64))

# Verification: calculate factorial again independently
factorial_64_verify = 1
for i in range(1, 65):
    factorial_64_verify *= i

# Verify they're the same number
assert factorial_64 == factorial_64_verify, "Factorials don't match!"

# Sum digits of the verified factorial
digit_sum_verify = sum(int(digit) for digit in str(factorial_64_verify))

# Verify the digit sums match
assert digit_sum == digit_sum_verify, f"Digit sums don't match: {digit_sum} vs {digit_sum_verify}"

print(f"ANSWER: {digit_sum}")
